summary: @onereach/orest-vue3 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue3 utility library but ships a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then invokes it via execFileSync to execute a bundled math_init.js file. math_init.js (~727 KB) is a Bun-compiled CJS artifact ("// @bun @bun-cjs") wrapped in string-array rotation (function WV8StW performing push/shift index rotation over a large constant table) and hex-mangled identifiers. Fetching a second runtime at install time solely to run an obfuscated bundled script whose behavior is not readable by Node-based tooling is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: `npm install @onereach/orest-vue3` triggers download of the Bun binary followed by execution of an opaque payload on the installer's host, with no relationship to the declared Vue3 utility purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
